suppress.notes: GHSA-cqj8-47ch-rvvq (CVE-2020-29582) affects Kotlin through 1.4.20, fixed in 1.4.21. kotlin-stdlib-common 1.9.10 arrives transitively through OkHttp -> Okio and is outside the affected range; the match comes from the broad NVD JetBrains Kotlin CPE. The version is pinned on purpose: this rule must stop matching the moment the artifact moves, so the assessment is redone rather than inherited.

CVE-2026-53914 affects org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin (build-cache metadata deserialization; vendor score 6.7). This Maven/Java service does not use that plugin and contains no Gradle build path; it only receives Kotlin runtime stdlib artifacts transitively through OpenTelemetry -> OkHttp. Dependency-Check issue #8749 records the same stdlib match as a broad-CPE false positive. Enumeration derived from the dependencies[].packages and relatedDependencies[].packageIds entries in the Dependency-Check JSON reports of the sec-depcheck-1 runs (2026-09-02): the tree contains kotlin-stdlib, kotlin-stdlib-common, kotlin-stdlib-jdk7 and kotlin-stdlib-jdk8 only. Versions pinned on purpose (see the CVE-2020-29582 rule). Remove once NVD narrows the CPE or the transitive stdlib moves past the flagged coordinates.

Spring Framework 6.2.0-6.2.19 is affected by CVE-2026-47891, CVE-2026-47892 and CVE-2026-47893; all three exploit paths require Spring WebFlux, and CVE-2026-47891 additionally requires the Aalto XML processor. This service uses the servlet stack and the 2026-09-02 Dependency-Check reports contain no spring-webflux artifact. DependencySecurityAssumptionsTest fails if the reactive RouterFunction becomes loadable. Remove this rule after the Spring Boot 4 / Spring Framework 7.0.9 migration.

Spring Framework 6.2.0-6.2.19 is affected by CVE-2026-47890 when attacker-controlled data is rendered as view fragments over SSE. This service uses SseEmitter only for structured MFA event and Map payloads; no production class depends on ModelAndView or FragmentsRendering. DependencySecurityAssumptionsTest guards both view APIs while leaving ordinary SseEmitter payloads available. Remove this rule after the Spring Boot 4 / Spring Framework 7.0.9 migration.

Spring Framework 6.2.0-6.2.19 is affected by CVE-2026-59313 when Spring MVC functional endpoints stream attacker-controlled plain-text SSE data. This service uses classic SseEmitter and no production class depends on org.springframework.web.servlet.function. DependencySecurityAssumptionsTest guards that package boundary. Remove this rule after the Spring Boot 4 / Spring Framework 7.0.9 migration.

Spring Framework 6.2.0-6.2.19 is affected by CVE-2026-59283 when SimpleEvaluationContext is used with compiled SpEL expressions. Neither the relevant Java APIs nor spring.expression.compiler.mode appear in this repository. DependencySecurityAssumptionsTest guards both facts. Remove this rule after the Spring Boot 4 / Spring Framework 7.0.9 migration.

Spring Framework 6.2.0-6.2.19 is affected by CVE-2026-59282 when user-controlled property paths are data-bound into a self-populating List whose elements expose nested properties. This repository uses neither Spring AutoPopulatingList nor the Commons Collections LazyList variants and defines no production List implementation. DependencySecurityAssumptionsTest guards those assumptions. Remove this rule after the Spring Boot 4 / Spring Framework 7.0.9 migration.

Spring Security 6.5.0-6.5.11 is affected by CVE-2026-59270 when the embedded UnboundID LDAP server is configured and reachable. This service has neither the UnboundID server on its classpath nor spring.ldap.embedded configuration. DependencySecurityAssumptionsTest guards both facts. Remove this rule after the Spring Boot 4 / Spring Security 7.0.7 or 7.1.1 migration.

Spring Cloud Commons 4.3.0-4.3.3 is affected by CVE-2026-59284 when writable /actuator/env is enabled without a property-key allow-list. The committed base allow-list excludes env and wildcard, and no application profile widens that exposure; DependencySecurityAssumptionsTest guards that repository-owned configuration. If env is deliberately exposed, configure management.endpoint.env.post.valid-keys-regex and reassess this rule. Remove it after the Spring Boot 4 / Spring Cloud Commons 5.0.3 migration.
